title: "Saved Not Spent"
date: "2008-02-27"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets", "Politics"]
---

[Finance Minister Lindsay Tanner](http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/story/0,25197,23282695-12377,00.html "Finance Minister Lindsay Tanner") launches a robust defence of the government’s tax cuts:

> “To the extent that there is a stimulatory impact ... it is actually far less than some people have been presenting.”…
>
> “Everybody ... assumes that every last dollar that every citizen gets in a tax cut will be spent and not saved - that’s a false assumption,” Mr Tanner said.

I make many of the same arguments [here](http://www.cis.org.au/executive_highlights/EH2007/ehkirchner.html "here").
